_comment: Humanization presets. Values grounded in drum-programming best practices: velocity jitter ~4% (+/-5 of 127), timing jitter <= ~10 ticks with kick/crash anchored to the grid, hi-hat hand cycle (down-beat loud, off-beats soft), backbeat snare accent, ghost notes at low velocity biased to the step before a main snare, fills that ramp velocity, and a two-hand simultaneity limit.

machine._desc: No humanization. Grid-perfect. For techno/electro where robotic IS the style.

tight._desc: Session drummer: subtle velocity/timing variation, hat cycle, anchored kick.

breaks._desc: Jungle/breakbeat feel: looser timing, laid-back snare, active ghosts, strong hat cycle.
